sources.title: ML - Multi-Task Learning - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Multi-task learning combines examples (soft limitations imposed on the parameters) from different tasks to improve generalization. When a section of a model is shared across tasks, it is more constrained to excellent values (if the sharing is acceptable), which often leads to better generalization.
